card.name: BE after SHOULD in capitalized warnings
card.fires_on: The word BE right after SHOULD in all-caps warning sentences, such as a drug SHOULD BE discontinued. It also fires weakly on AND in an all-caps list of risks.

modes.label: SHOULD BE in caps
modes.description: BE following SHOULD in an all-caps drug warning sentence, before a verb like discontinued or withheld.
modes.example: FELBAMATE ORAL SUSPENSION SHOULD<< BE>> DISCONTINUED IF EITHER SERUM

modes.label: AND in caps risk list
modes.description: AND between capitalized risk terms in a boxed warning headline.
modes.example: and DEPENDENCE<< AND>> WITHDRAWAL REACTIONS See full
